tasks.notes: Vitest configured in vite.config.ts, happy-dom environment, coverage reporting enabled, mock files created

GitHub Actions workflow created at .github/workflows/test.yml. Runs tests on push to main and PRs, enforces 80% coverage threshold, includes linting and type checking, uploads coverage reports to Codecov and as artifacts.
